pages.title: Ethiopian Wolf
pages.text: The Ethiopian wolf ($(o)Canis simensis$()) lives only in the Afroalpine grasslands of the Ethiopian highlands, above 3,000 metres.$(br2)It is a slender, long-legged wolf with a long, narrow muzzle, a bright ginger-red coat, a white throat, chest and belly, and a black-tipped tail.$(br2)Packs share a territory, but each wolf hunts alone, mostly for giant mole-rats. With fewer than 500 adults left, it is Africa's most endangered carnivore.
